**Licence**

**Claim label**
- [ ] PUBLIC (published record)
- [ ] RECORDED (documented observation)
- [ ] PROJECTED (forecast or model)
- [ ] Reconstruction (`reconstruction: true`), based on:

**History (if this is a history entry)**
- [ ] It has at least one official source
- [ ] Hard history is included; nothing difficult was left out to soften the timeline
- [ ] The date falls in 1775–2026

**Privacy check**
- [ ] It does not identify or locate private people (no owner names, home addresses, phone numbers or emails).
- [ ] It is not an entry about a living person
